project.title: Rijksmuseum Conversational AI Interface
project.description: Research into a conversational interface that enriches visits inside the Rijksmuseum, with Q42 and Curamando.
project.introText: A conversational interface that helps visitors learn about and engage with the Rijksmuseum collection inside the museum. It is the Data Systems Project of the MSc Information Studies (2026/27), with Q42 and Curamando as stakeholders.
project.middleText: The brief asks what a visitor needs for a rich experience in the galleries and which interface attributes contribute to it, from input and output modalities to visual widgets and the context a conversation sits in, and how that experience can be measured.
project.context: Data Systems Project, MSc Information Studies (University of Amsterdam), 2026/27, with Q42 and Curamando as stakeholders

summary.brief: Conversational interfaces are everywhere, but they rarely enrich a visit inside the museum.
summary.role: Designer and researcher in a team, MSc Information Studies Data Systems Project.
summary.method: Research into what makes a rich visit and which interface attributes support it, with Q42 and Curamando.

project.shows: Research-led interface design with industry stakeholders.
